def: The HTTP header carrying the MCP protocol version on Streamable HTTP requests, required since 2025-06-18 and, since 2026-07-28, required to match the version in the request's _meta.
practice: A mismatch returns 400 with a HeaderMismatch error; since 2026-07-28 POSTs must also carry Mcp-Method and, for tools/call, resources/read and prompts/get, Mcp-Name, so gateways can route without parsing bodies.
